weakness.title: Insufficient Review of Access Logs
weakness.description: Access logs are recorded but not reviewed, or are reviewed too rarely or too superficially to reveal unauthorized or abnormal access.

extended_description.applicability: Access control records, visitor registers and key logs, whether automated or manual. Includes reviews that are not assigned, not scheduled, not documented, or limited to a search made after an incident.
extended_description.exploitation: An unauthorized or abusive access appears in the records but is not noticed, because no one examines them or the examination comes long after the event.

row.details: Abnormal access remains in the records unnoticed.
Repeated or ongoing unauthorized access continues because it is not identified.
Misuse of access rights is not attributed or sanctioned.

row.description: Name who reviews access records, with a deputy, independent of those whose access is reviewed.
Review records on a schedule set by the sensitivity of the area, and after any related alert or incident.
Check for access outside normal hours, repeated denied attempts, unused rights, and entries that do not match a duty or visit.
Record each review and its findings, and handle anomalies through the response process.
Reviewers see individuals' movements. Their access to records must be limited and justified, in accordance with applicable law.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-6 Monitoring Physical Access
ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A: 7.4 Physical security monitoring
